name: Moon lander
description: Moon lander, in chunky pixels: turn the lander and fire its engine against the pull of gravity to set it down on a landing pad, slowly and upright, before the fuel runs out. The ground is jagged and new every level, with one to three flat pads that multiply the landing's score (x2, x3, x5: the narrower, the more); the instruments show altitude and horizontal and vertical speed, green when they are safe to land. Each level brings stronger gravity and less fuel; a crash costs one of three landers. Turn with the buttons on the screen, the arrow keys or A/D, or the frame's buttons; fire the engine by holding the boost button, holding a finger on the sky, Up, W or Space (P pauses). Settings: difficulty. The best five scores are kept. Needs a fast screen (LCD or HDMI): on e-paper it shows a title card with the high scores. High contrast (black on white) is automatic on black-and-white panels, or set it under Contrast. Holding a key the frame's Button actions bind still does that; a short press plays.
